report.note: Report-generation success is not qualification success. The maintained summary native_calls1740 excludes the241 partial failed-host calls; this record retains all1981.

statistics.endpoint: NATIVE_SECONDS: complete native estimation call; runtime and solver phase diagnostics are separate columns.
statistics.block_score: Geometric mean of two calls per arm. Excess=candidate-reference-max(5% of reference,0.001seconds).
statistics.host_score: Median of the two block excesses on each physical host. Report median_ratio is median of all six retained block ratios, not a ratio of pooled call medians.
statistics.bounds: Unchanged one-sided alpha0.025 median bounds need more than three independent units; lower/upper are null at n3. Six-host gate also fails for every endpoint.
statistics.descriptive_findings: All four eight-/sixteen-FE T1/T4 host-median excesses are positive on each of the three valid hosts. These are descriptive adverse observations, not six-host regression verdicts.
statistics.limits: No simultaneous interval claim. Three failed tasks ran sequentially on the same physical host; neither those tasks nor their individual calls create independent units. All partial timings remain visible without being selected into the scorer.

science.maintained_report_science_checks: Completed-host independent-reference, cross-arm and cross-worker checks passed; all three blocked tasks have the exact diagnosed operational missing-process-observation failure. No scientific tolerance changed.
science.partial_scope: A partial task supplies no complete-host qualification claim, even when earlier cells finished successfully.

observer.selection: Whole-host completion rule applied to all original tasks; no timing-based exclusion, replacement, or averaging of partial cells.
observer.limits: Sampled reservation/census/process evidence is retained by hashes; no inference that an observer gap is competing computation or a scientific failure.

provenance.retention: All1981 timing rows retained below, including397 warmups and all241 partial-host calls. Raw collected result/host/accounting files remain retained during the unfinished task. No native estimation or new timing was performed by this audit.
